notes.title: Android Version open for beta testing
notes.notes:
If you have an Android mobile or tablet device I invite you to test my new Ultimate Rock Crawler Game on that platform, for free!

Go to
https://play.google.com/apps/testing/kim.hoskin.rockcrawler 

Take part in the Beta test and give me feedback, good, bad or Ugly.
Thanks, I hope you enjoy this mobile device version.

notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

The recent update includes the following changes/features:
-Now you can set custom Input Keys for all features for Winch, show route, gear change, camera views, change 4 to 2 wheel drive, difflock, change body. You do this on the initial Game's configuration dialog screen, on the Input Tab. This should make it much easier to control and drive your rock crawler the way you want.
-Some minor performance improvements to the in game additional cameras.
-Improved camera behaviour further, should help with even less  jerkiness/artefacts than before.
-Now by default you start in Four wheel drive mode. Making it easier to drive over bigger rocks with ease,  previously, initially you would start in two wheel drive mode.
-Improved Headlight on / off action more, with different lensflares.

I wish you happy Rock Crawling, watch out for further updates that are planned.

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, 

Ultimate Rock Crawler now includes a number of fixes. See below:

-Much improved Menu, no more blurring on menu, menu shows on all camera options.

See previous updates for additional changes, included below:
-Gear indication now present (hover over ? icon in game), 
-Camera now makes objects in-between car and camera transparent, this helps to avoid jaggy/jittery camera behaviour and make for smoother/better game play (exception is if trying to go into the ground, to prevent camera from going underground), 
-T Key (Show Route Assist) now listed in the In game ? Icon, use the T key to show route helper in case you are not sure where the next gate is. 
-Cannot go into Dept in Garage area now, 
-Added Buy Winches option,  now you can have as many winches as you can afford.
-Number of Winches now listed in the In game ? Icon, 
-Gate passed sound now added, 
-Added more useful Tips on Intro and Garage Sections, 
-Scoring System calculated differently/simpler, 
-Lens Flares on Headlight improved. 

Wishing you happy Rock Crawling :)
